free-agents.source: public.players p LEFT JOIN public.roster_players r ON r.player_id=p.id AND r.league_id=p_league_id AND r.league_season_id=selected_season LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(w.clears_at) AS clears_at FROM public.waiver_wire_log w WHERE w.player_id=p.id AND w.league_id=p_league_id AND w.league_season_id=selected_season AND w.cleared_at IS NULL AND w.clears_at>now()) hold ON true

availability.sql: CASE WHEN hold.clears_at IS NULL THEN 'free-agent' ELSE 'waivers' END

rosters.source: public.roster_players r JOIN public.players p ON p.id=r.player_id JOIN public.league_members m ON m.id=r.member_id AND m.league_id=r.league_id

standings.source: public.league_members m LEFT JOIN public.standings_current c ON c.member_id=m.id AND c.league_season_id=selected_season

matchups.source: public.matchups m JOIN public.league_members h ON h.id=m.home_member_id AND h.league_id=m.league_id JOIN public.league_members a ON a.id=m.away_member_id AND a.league_id=m.league_id
matchups.where: m.league_id=p_league_id AND m.league_season_id=selected_season AND NOT m.is_voided

scores.source: public.matchups m JOIN public.league_members h ON h.id=m.home_member_id AND h.league_id=m.league_id JOIN public.league_members a ON a.id=m.away_member_id AND a.league_id=m.league_id
scores.where: m.league_id=p_league_id AND m.league_season_id=selected_season AND NOT m.is_voided

schedule.source: public.matchups m JOIN public.league_members h ON h.id=m.home_member_id AND h.league_id=m.league_id JOIN public.league_members a ON a.id=m.away_member_id AND a.league_id=m.league_id
schedule.where: m.league_id=p_league_id AND m.league_season_id=selected_season AND NOT m.is_voided

player-stats.source: public.players p LEFT JOIN public.player_season_averages c ON c.player_id=p.id AND c.league_id=p_league_id AND c.season_year=selected_year LEFT JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages a ON a.player_id=p.id AND a.season_year=selected_year LEFT JOIN public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points fp ON fp.player_id=p.id AND fp.league_id=p_league_id AND fp.season_year=selected_year

projections.source: public.players p LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.get_league_projection_rows(p_league_id,selected_year,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date,'today',ARRAY[p.id],1,0) pr ON true

drafts.where: d.league_id=p_league_id AND d.league_season_id=selected_season AND NOT d.is_mock

draft-results.source: (SELECT s.id,s.draft_id,s.member_id,s.player_id,s.overall_pick,s.round,s.picked_at,NULL::integer AS price FROM public.snake_draft_picks s WHERE s.player_id IS NOT NULL AND s.picked_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT n.id,n.draft_id,n.winning_member_id,n.player_id,n.nomination_order,NULL::integer,n.closed_at,n.final_price FROM public.nominations n WHERE n.status='sold' AND n.winning_member_id IS NOT NULL) pick JOIN public.drafts d ON d.id=pick.draft_id JOIN public.players p ON p.id=pick.player_id JOIN public.league_members m ON m.id=pick.member_id AND m.league_id=d.league_id
draft-results.where: d.league_id=p_league_id AND d.league_season_id=selected_season AND NOT d.is_mock AND d.status='completed'

trades.source: public.trades t JOIN public.league_seasons s ON s.id=t.league_season_id AND s.league_id=t.league_id
trades.where: t.league_id=p_league_id AND t.status='completed' AND t.completed_at IS NOT NULL

teamIds.sql: ARRAY(SELECT participant.member_id::text FROM public.trade_participants participant WHERE participant.trade_id=t.id AND participant.league_id=t.league_id ORDER BY participant.member_id)

trade-assets.source: public.trade_items i JOIN public.trades t ON t.id=i.trade_id AND t.league_id=i.league_id JOIN public.league_seasons s ON s.id=t.league_season_id AND s.league_id=t.league_id LEFT JOIN public.players p ON p.id=i.player_id LEFT JOIN public.draft_picks pick ON pick.id=i.pick_id AND pick.league_id=i.league_id
trade-assets.where: t.league_id=p_league_id AND t.status='completed' AND t.completed_at IS NOT NULL

kind.sql: CASE WHEN i.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'player' WHEN i.pick_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'pick' ELSE 'budget' END

transactions.source: (SELECT tx.id,tx.league_id,tx.league_season_id,tx.member_id,tx.player_id,tx.transaction_type,tx.occurred_at,tx.related_trade_id FROM public.roster_transactions tx WHERE tx.transaction_type IN ('fa_add','fa_drop','waiver_add','waiver_drop','trade_in','trade_out','draft_won','carry_over') AND (tx.transaction_type NOT IN ('trade_in','trade_out') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.trades t WHERE t.id=tx.related_trade_id AND t.league_id=tx.league_id AND t.status='completed' AND t.completed_at IS NOT NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT a.id,a.league_id,a.league_season_id,a.actor_member_id,a.related_player_id,a.event_type,a.created_at,a.related_trade_id FROM public.league_activity a JOIN public.trades t ON t.id=a.related_trade_id AND t.league_id=a.league_id AND t.status='completed' AND t.completed_at IS NOT NULL WHERE a.event_type='trade_completed') tx LEFT JOIN public.players p ON p.id=tx.player_id LEFT JOIN public.league_members m ON m.id=tx.member_id AND m.league_id=tx.league_id

tradeId.sql: CASE WHEN tx.transaction_type IN ('trade_in','trade_out','trade_completed') THEN tx.related_trade_id END
